title: Venue and vendor selection + position merge
description: Take independent logistics, commercial, and safety positions on the same options, then merge them so every conflict surfaces as a decision before anything is signed.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-evnt-01
  title: Venue and vendor selection + position merge
  description: Take independent logistics, commercial, and safety positions on the same options, then
    merge them so every conflict surfaces as a decision before anything is signed.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Select a venue and vendor set where logistics feasibility, contract protection, and safety
    were argued separately and their conflicts resolved before commitment.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Event brief and candidate options
      summary: Event brief and candidate options
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - event_brief
              - candidate_venues
              - vendor_proposals
              - budget_envelope
            properties:
              event_brief: {}
              candidate_venues: {}
              vendor_proposals: {}
              budget_envelope: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-split
      kind: transform
      name: Select the sections under review
      summary: select the candidate options and the attributes each reviewer takes a position on
      config:
        operation: select
        expression: select the candidate options and the attributes each reviewer takes a position on
    - id: n-position1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: evnt-01
      name: Logistics and capacity position
      summary: 'Independent position 1: logistics and capacity position.'
      role: Coordinator matching event requirements to venue capability and constraint.
      prompt: You are a Venue & Logistics Coordinator. You test a venue against the event's real requirements
        — capacity under the intended layout, load-in access, power, rigging, kitchen throughput, accessible
        routes — and you cite the venue document behind each figure. You verify licensed capacity for
        the specific configuration rather than the headline number, because that difference is where events
        get shut down.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - teaching
          - evaluation
          - operations-planning
          - accessibility
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:event-management
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-position2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: evnt-02
      name: Commercial and contract position
      summary: 'Independent position 2: commercial and contract position.'
      role: Vendor manager scoping suppliers and the terms that protect the event.
      prompt: You are a Vendor & Contract Manager. You scope each vendor's deliverable, timing, and failure
        remedy precisely, and you check cancellation, force majeure, and attrition terms against the event's
        actual risk. You state what happens if a vendor fails on the day, because an event has no second
        attempt and a remedy that pays out later is not a remedy.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - contract-analysis
          - risk-analysis
          - evaluation
          - teaching
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:contract-lifecycle
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-position3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: evnt-05
      name: Safety and crowd position
      summary: 'Independent position 3: safety and crowd position.'
      role: Safety planner covering crowd, medical, weather, and emergency response.
      prompt: You are an Event Risk & Safety Planner. You plan crowd flow and density, medical provision,
        weather triggers, and evacuation routes against the actual attendee profile and site, with the
        decision-maker for each trigger named. You define the stop-the-event authority explicitly, because
        the moment to use it is not the moment to establish who holds it.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - risk-analysis
          - incident-response
          - quantitative-analysis
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-merge
      kind: aggregator
      name: Merge positions and surface collisions
      summary: Combine the position objects field by field; where two positions disagree on the same field,
        the collision is the finding.
      config:
        aggregation: merge
    - id: n-collisions
      kind: condition
      name: Collisions to resolve?
      summary: Route on merged.collisions is empty.
      config:
        expression: merged.collisions is empty
        branches:
          - label: Aligned
            when: aligned
          - label: Collisions
            when: collisions
    - id: n-resolve
      kind: agent
      templateRef: evnt-06
      name: Resolve conflicts into one recommended selection
      summary: Work each collision to a recommended position with a stated fallback.
      role: Controller keeping the event budget honest through commitment and change.
      prompt: You are an Event Budget Controller. You track committed, spent, and forecast cost separately,
        price every change request before it is approved, and keep contingency visible rather than absorbed.
        You flag the point at which cancellation costs exceed proceeding costs, because that threshold
        is the last moment a real decision exists.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - compliance-review
          - domain-analysis
          - finance-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:erp
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Event owner approves the selection before contracts are signed
      summary: Pause for the event owner; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Venue and vendor selection + position merge deliverable, the evidence
        behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-evnt-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-split
      kind: data
    - id: wf-evnt-01-edge-2
      from: n-split
      to: n-position1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-evnt-01-edge-3
      from: n-split
      to: n-position2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-evnt-01-edge-4
      from: n-split
      to: n-position3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-evnt-01-edge-5
      from: n-position1
      to: n-merge
      kind: data
    - id: wf-evnt-01-edge-6
      from: n-position2
      to: n-merge
      kind: data
    - id: wf-evnt-01-edge-7
      from: n-position3
      to: n-merge
      kind: data
    - id: wf-evnt-01-edge-8
      from: n-merge
      to: n-collisions
      kind: data
    - id: wf-evnt-01-edge-9
      from: n-collisions
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: aligned
    - id: wf-evnt-01-edge-10
      from: n-collisions
      to: n-resolve
      kind: control
      condition: collisions
    - id: wf-evnt-01-edge-11
      from: n-resolve
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-evnt-01-edge-12
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
